shadows.name: --shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Flat publication surfaces; no article or button lift.

shadows.name: notice-shadow
shadows.purpose: Transient fixed status notice; the color token changes with theme.

motion.name: --ease-out
motion.purpose: Control-state easing; not the bookmark's spring.

motion.name: contents-spring-stiffness
motion.purpose: Native JS unit-mass spring in public/assets/contents.js; selector-level behavior, not a CSS property.

motion.name: contents-spring-damping
motion.purpose: Critically damped feel, damping ratio approximately 1.01; retargets with current velocity.

motion.name: contents-rest-displacement
motion.purpose: Snap to target when displacement and velocity are both below their rest thresholds.

motion.name: contents-rest-velocity
motion.purpose: Velocity threshold for stopping animation frames.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Base CSS transition/animation reduction; bookmark snaps, scroll behavior is auto, iteration count is one.

motion.name: notice-duration
motion.purpose: Shared polite status notice lifetime in app.js; not a decorative animation.

narrative.overview:
A cool-paper publication frame pairs ink-blue fields with measured rules and generous reading margins. The independent-bookshop character comes from typography, dated writing and a marginal bookmark. It accommodates technical notes and personal essays without assigning a fictional identity to the owner.

Public pages prioritize comprehension; the private writing workspace uses the same materials at a denser, task-oriented scale. Display lettering frames the publication while sans-serif controls and native Markdown editing keep work direct. Motion reports reading position or a control state; the page has no decorative ambient animation.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, dark ink and one indigo accent family in light and dark appearances.
Chinese serif display, Latin blackletter display, sans-serif reading and controls, code-only monospace including Markdown source.
Flat publication surfaces, hairline separators and double-rule framing.
Dated article rows, a leading article field and a section-following marginal bookmark.
Editable identity, clearly disclosed local examples and truthful empty states.

rules.name: The Field Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep field text, field metadata and field focus on their dedicated inverse tokens; ordinary muted ink does not belong on the indigo leading article.

rules.name: The Two Reading Voices Rule
rules.body: Use display type to frame public writing and sans-serif to read, scan and operate; reserve monospace for code and Markdown source.

rules.name: The Flat Publication Rule
rules.body: Separate reading surfaces with tone and rules; reserve the floating shadow for transient notices.

rules.name: The Explicit Publication Rule
rules.body: Enter and the first save action preserve the current publication status; only the explicit publication action publishes or withdraws a post.

dos: Do preserve cool-paper/ink roles across themes and use dedicated inverse tokens on the indigo article field.
Do use the shared frame, spacing steps and nearly square controls; let full article titles wrap on phones.
Do keep display type in the publication frame and sans-serif in reading, metadata and administration.
Do retain real anchors, native forms, visible focus and field-associated feedback with panel reveal.
Do preserve publication status on Enter and report only the server-confirmed save result.
Do label local demonstration content and let missing owner material produce honest empty states.
donts: Don't treat `个人博客`, fixture titles, sample dates or browser-check text as confirmed owner identity or history.
Don't replace the article index with repeated raised cards or pad the opening into a promotional full-screen hero.
Don't turn the `radius-pill` token into capsule geometry or use monospace for dates and navigation.
Don't add decorative ambient animation; the bookmark moves only to explain reading position.
Don't hide errors in the other editing panel or change publication state through an implicit save.
Don't infer imagery, texture, crop treatment or additional components from unused foundation hooks.
